summary: Frontend-only test of the new Professional Legal Report (LEGAL LENS) feature + Foundation Statement flow. Almost all acceptance criteria pass. One spec deviation found: the 'Other Professional Comments' textarea (legal-lens-professional_comments) is NOT prefilled with an 'AI-Assisted Draft' string on generation — the other 5 lens fields are. Root cause: backend legal_ai.py LENS_KEYS returns only 5 keys, and legal_report.py LENS_MAP maps only 5 ai keys to fields (professional_comments has no AI mapping). Everything else verified: (1) /joint/{rid} card renders with legal-report-card, legal-report-badge='LEGAL LENS', legal-report-status='Status: Not Started', legal-report-sample-btn and legal-report-create-btn='Create Professional Legal Report'. (2) legal-report-sample-btn → /joint/{rid}/legal-report/sample renders legal-sample-title, sections legal-s1..legal-s12 (safety absent for this case), legal-parent-a/b with 'PARENT-REPORTED INFORMATION' badge, legal-certified block, legal-sample-back='Back to Case', legal-sample-create-btn='Create My Report' → /joint/{rid}/legal-report. (3) Create page: title='Create Professional Legal Report', availability rows correct (assessment_a Complete, joint Complete, medical 'Not Applicable', notes 'None'); click legal-generate-btn → toast, title becomes 'Professional Legal Report', pill='Draft'; s1..s7 render; legal-lens-section shows legal-ai-label containing 'AI-ASSISTED DRAFT' (source: AI GPT-5.4 mini). 5/6 lens textareas prefilled with 'AI-Assisted Draft' — professional_comments empty (bug). Edited professional_comments, ticked 2 legal-option, added custom option (OWN badge visible), ticked 2 legal-path, filled explanation, clicked legal-save-btn → 'Draft saved' toast, pill='Professional Review'; reload persists values. (4) legal-finalize-btn disabled until cert-checkbox+certified_name set. legal-preview-btn shows legal-preview with legal-s8..s12 and legal-not-certified 'NOT YET CERTIFIED — DRAFT'; legal-edit-btn returns to edit. After cert+name filled → finalize enabled; legal-finalize-dialog shows 'Finalizing this report will create a dated professional version…', legal-finalize-cancel closes; legal-finalize-confirm → toast 'Finalized — version 1', pill='Finalized', legal-versions='1 finalized version', legal-certified in preview, legal-pdf-btn='Export Final PDF'. GET /api/professional-legal-reports/{rid}/pdf → 200 application/pdf. /joint/{rid} card refreshes to 'Status: Finalized' + 'Continue Professional Legal Report'. (5) legal-regenerate-btn → 'Draft regenerated' toast, pill back to Draft, lens fields reset to AI drafts. (6) Parent A login: GET /api/cases/{rid}/professional-legal-report returns 403; UI shows 'Professional access required.' toast, no crash (stays on legal-report-loading skeleton). (7) Foundation Statement: on fresh joint_report case, /joint/{rid}/assess renders foundation-card with foundation-text textarea for parent A; filled + answered all 6 questions + submitted → 'responses saved'. After both parents complete, pro generates legal report → legal-avail-foundation_a='Complete' and legal-parent-a contains heading 'Foundation Statement (parent's own words)' with the parent's text. (8) Public /samples/legal-report renders legal-sample-page without login, legal-sample-back='Sample Reports', NO legal-sample-create-btn. /samples has sample-view-link-legal-report. Mobile 390px on /joint/{rid}/legal-report and /samples/legal-report: body/inner widths equal (bw=iw=390), no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: AI generator (legal_ai.py) only emits 5 lens keys; legal_report.LENS_MAP maps 5 fields. The 6th UI field 'professional_comments' (Other Professional Comments) is never prefilled with an 'AI-Assisted Draft' stub, contradicting spec 'six textareas legal-lens-* prefilled starting with AI-Assisted Draft'.

ui_bugs.issue: legal-lens-professional_comments is empty after generate/regenerate (should be prefilled with 'AI-Assisted Draft — Professional Review Required. …'). Other 5 lens fields are prefilled correctly.

action_items: In /app/backend/legal_ai.py add a 6th key (e.g. 'other_professional_comments') to LENS_KEYS + rule_based_lens + system prompt, and in /app/backend/legal_report.py add {"other_professional_comments": "professional_comments"} to LENS_MAP so that all six legal-lens textareas are seeded with an 'AI-Assisted Draft — Professional Review Required.' stub on both generate and regenerate. This is the only spec deviation.
critical_code_review_comments: legal_ai.LENS_KEYS is out of sync with the LegalReport.jsx LENS list (5 vs 6). Either extend the AI schema/rule-based fallback to include 'other_professional_comments', or update the spec/test to drop the prefill requirement for that field.

LegalReport.jsx: 'legal-edit-btn' data-testid is used on TWO buttons (line 97 inside the preview banner and line 105 sticky action bar aliased 'legal-edit-btn-2'). Consider consolidating to avoid duplicate testid ambiguity.
LegalReportSample.jsx swallows API errors with .catch(() => {}) — if the sample endpoint fails, the page stays on legal-sample-loading forever with no user feedback.

If main agent adds the 6th LENS_KEY the retest should simply verify (i) after generate, legal-lens-professional_comments value startswith 'AI-Assisted Draft', and (ii) after regenerate it is reset again. Endpoints /api/professional-legal-reports/{rid}/pdf and /api/cases/{rid}/professional-legal-report both work (200 and 403 respectively).
rca of the issue: Frontend LegalReport.jsx defines 6 lens fields: observations, further_attention, alignment_areas, partial_alignment, procedural_considerations, professional_comments. Backend legal_ai.LENS_KEYS only defines 5 (professional_observations, issues_requiring_attention, existing_agreements, agreement_building_opportunities, procedural_considerations). legal_report.LENS_MAP maps only these 5 to their frontend field names. On generate/regenerate the frontend field 'professional_comments' therefore stays '' (empty). Fix: add 'other_professional_comments' (or 'professional_comments') to LENS_KEYS, rule_based_lens fallback dict, the OpenAI system prompt schema (line 26 in legal_ai.py), and LENS_MAP in legal_report.py.
